spans.s:
ओह, अस्, m. (fr. 2. ऊह्), Ved. meditation; (Sāy.)
bringing, performing; reaching.
—ओह-ब्रह्मन्, आ,
m., Ved. really a Brāhman, a Brāhman valued as one;
(Sāy.) one who has sacred knowledge.
ओहल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
ओहस्, अस्, n., Ved. idea, true notion; (Sāy.) praise.
ओहान, अस्, आ, अम्, considering, reflecting on.
